name: TV DIABLO Windows
note: v3418: REG-1145. HIS RULING: raise the cap to 26000 - the call #143 had been waiting on since v3299 left the cost with him. THE OLD NUMBER JUSTIFICATION HAD DIED WHILE THE NUMBER LIVED: the comment above MAX_FENCE_CHARS said 24,000 chars timed out at 240s, true when written and measured against an EYE_TIMEOUT_S later raised to 1200 after a 22,519-char payload was killed at 300s, so the ceiling it protected against no longer existed and the evidence had quietly stopped being about the eye at all. WHAT 9,000 COST, on three versions in one day: v3413 answered cannot-tell with 0 findings at 8,622 chars and returned 5 findings at 25,074; v3414 never sent control_ui.html, the file the version is ABOUT; v3417 never sent 4 of its 5 changed files. Measured after the raise, v3417 payload goes 8,976 to 25,990 chars, reach 34 percent to 99.2 percent. 26,000 IS INSIDE WITNESSED TERRITORY: the ledger holds SEVEN completed looks at or above 26,000 chars, the largest 37,973. THE LAW THIS SHIPS WITH CUTS BOTH WAYS - a cap may only be a size the eye has actually been SEEN to finish at, refusing a blind raise and equally refusing a quiet lowering. An EMPTY SEAT is not a witness: it proves the payload left, never that the eye could chew it. Gate builds its OWN temp ledger so it is never a runner skip: 10 cases, 1 BASELINE, 3 RED_PROOFs all PROVEN. Heart row the eye cap is a size it has finished compares the SHIPPED cap against the largest payload this machine has seen answered - live OK at 26 ms, 6 branches driven, 5 non-OK, and UNKNOWN is a real answer for a machine with no finished look. RESIDUAL not fixed here: at 26,000 bible.html and control_ui.html still do not reach on a v3417-sized diff because MIN_USEFUL_SLICE drops a file whose share falls below 1,500 - a share-allocation question, not a cap question.
